model.geologicalTimeStatus: effective solver time, not historical canon
model.rainStatus: two-season terrain-conditioned estimate, not a general circulation model
model.lakeRouting: virtual spill levels for runoff; bedrock is never globally filled
model.iceStatus: temperature-dependent snow display only; ice flow/erosion is not yet simulated
model.seedAmplitudeStatus: uncalibrated AI brightness converted to bounded zero-mean priors; physical metres follow declared blending weights
model.resolution: continent 2 km; periphery 1 km; protected-area comparison 250 m; existing Orun 64 m preserved
model.plateCount: not inferred from bulk density; fault-block diversity is a morphological prior
model.stage: new terrain substrate with a small drainage pilot; full wind/water/thermal/aeolian/stratigraphic evolution deferred by author
model.lakePolicy: lakes >=200 km2 and scene-related water retained; smaller unanchored inferred lake dots are released for later hydrological re-evaluation

geologicalProtection.desertPolicy: back-plateau outside main terraform footprint; local watercut refuges remain
